text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
May I ask what you thought of my
running today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the most part, she was as confident
as ever on
the track...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But now that I think about it, she might
have
looked a little tired.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So you thought the same... Perhaps I
should start
paying more attention to my
body's needs and
give myself some rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not that you're at fault, of course. We've
both
been pushing ourselves a little too
hard of late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We must both strive to keep one
another at the
top of our game.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has a point. It might be
wise to
rethink our schedule.
